summary: In traditional menu style, answering ? to the container action prompt should display the Container actions text window and then resume the prompt. C routes this to pickup.c:explain_container_prompt; JavaScript currently throws UnsupportedPickupError at the caller.

source.branch: When use_container reaches its traditional menu action prompt and the user answers ?, explain_container_prompt displays its fixed NHW_TEXT help lines, omitting the Next line when no additional container is selected.
callers: use_container in pickup.c at the '?' dispatch (3117-3118)

evidence: nethack-c/upstream/src/pickup.c:2910-2940 defines the entire static explain_container_prompt(boolean) helper: create NHW_TEXT; emit the fixed action lines in order; skip the ' n -- Next' line when more_containers is false; display; destroy.
nethack-c/upstream/src/pickup.c:3117-3118 calls explain_container_prompt(more_containers) from use_container whenever the traditional action prompt returns '?'.

js/pickup.js:2239-2244 has the matching caller branch but throws UnsupportedPickupError instead of displaying the help text. This is a missing source helper, so the task is a whole-function port of explain_container_prompt and its production caller wiring; it does not claim whole-function completion for use_container.
The existing JS tty_menu.js:displayTtyTextWindow owns the NHW_TEXT TTY display, dismissal, destruction, and screen repair sequence and can serve as the display dependency.
